entries.title: Graduate Researcher — Hypersonic Vehicles
entries.description: State estimation for fault-tolerant control of hypersonic vehicles in Simulink and C++. Analyzed hypersonic flight test data to characterize vehicle behavior and inform estimator design.

entries.title: Woodruff Graduate Leaders Fellow
entries.org: Georgia Tech, Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering
entries.description: Selected to the inaugural 22-fellow cohort from the College of Engineering. Represented graduate student concerns to administration, proposing solutions adopted into the program's continuation.

entries.title: Flight Test Engineering Course Assistant
entries.description: Primary point of contact for 60 students per semester on lab, hardware, and flight-dynamics questions. Built Simulink flight-dynamics models integrated with X-Plane 12, and stood up shared simulator procedures in the course's inaugural semester.

entries.title: Graduate Researcher — Solar Seaplane (Dissertation)
entries.description: Dissertation work on a solar-powered seaplane UAV for autonomous ocean monitoring. MDP flight planning, aerodynamic analysis, and flight testing.

entries.title: Undergraduate Research Mentor
entries.description: Mentored over 25 undergraduate researchers across machine design, manufacturing, controls, and flight testing. Mentees have advanced to Sandia National Laboratories, Bell, and aerospace-robotics PhD programs.

entries.title: Graduate Researcher — Drone Capture System
entries.description: Autonomy for aerial interceptor drone. ROS2 control stack, RRT* path planning, and mechanical grasping payload.

entries.title: R&D Engineering Intern
entries.description: Vision-based depth perception with RANSAC/Open3D point cloud processing. Autonomous powerwashing demo with 6DOF manipulator and ROS2.

entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher
entries.description: ROS2 nodes for autonomous quadcopter landing. IR camera gimbal system for precision tracking.

entries.title: RoboJackets — Team Mentor & Board Member
entries.description: Mentoring undergraduate combat robotics teams on design, fabrication, and competition strategy. Serve on the board of RoboJackets Inc., the 501(c)(3) managing sponsorship funds and competition winnings for the club.

entries.title: Robotic Manufacturing Intern
entries.description: Programmed Fanuc robot + CNC lathe automation cell. Achieved 75% cycle time reduction, $40K annual savings, and a further $12K cost-out in forging material handling.

entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher
entries.org: Georgia Tech, Adaptive Robotic Manipulation Lab
entries.description: Low-level motor control for pneumatic knee exoskeleton. Published at Design of Medical Devices Conference 2021.

entries.title: RoboJackets — Team Lead
entries.description: Led the competitive combat robotics team. Oversaw design, manufacturing, and competition logistics.

entries.title: RoboJackets — Sponsorship Chair
entries.description: Managed corporate sponsorships and partnerships for the organization.

entries.title: Engineering Intern
entries.description: Eddy current braking prototype, vacuum thermoforming table, hemi-anechoic chamber design and build.

entries.title: RoboJackets — Mech Training Lead / 3lb Mentor
entries.description: Trained new members on mechanical design and fabrication. Mentored 3lb combat robot teams.

entries.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern

entries.title: Emerging Leaders — Member, then Board of Advisors
entries.description: Completed a year-long leadership program with a 30-student cohort, then returned for two years on the Board of Advisors — shaping cohort selection, curriculum, and the fall retreat for each incoming class.
